evaluation_semantics: Independent mean heteroscedastic Gaussian negative log likelihood with physical drift gauges and Fourier/variance-derived array consistency; no precision-loss optimizer parameter identity.
likelihood_definition: 0.5 mean(log(v)+(x-zeta)^2/v), with numerical v in pA squared; additive constant omitted. Reported noise amplitudes are corrected by sqrt(50/49), so likelihood variance is reported variance times49/50.
reference_type: Attainable likelihood, not actual waveform/noise truth
tolerance_provenance: Declared mean log-likelihood numerical budget1e-6 per measured sample; derived arrays1e-7 relative L2; not confidence bounds.
